What is a Trade License and Why Do You Need It?

A trade license is your legal permission slip to do business in Sharjah. From opening a store, offering services, or launching an online business. In short, you can’t operate legally without it.

The Sharjah Economic Development Department is the official body in Sharjah. The SEDD issues trade licenses for businesses outside free zones.

The Process: How to Get a Trade License in Sharjah

If you’re launching your business soon in Sharjah and seeking your trade license, then look no further. We’ve a simplified roadmap to getting your trade license:

  1. Choose Your Business Activities

The first step is to pick the exact activities your business will offer. You can choose up to 10 activities under one license. Check the approved activity list on SEDD’s website.

  1. Select the Right Business Structure

Your company’s legal form defines ownership, liability, and management. The common options include sole proprietorship, ideal for individuals, the limited liability company, based on shared ownership, and the corporation for professionals.

  1. Reserve a Business Name

Choose a unique name that matches your business activity. Select something that hasn’t been used before. The name must follow the UAE naming guidelines. Be sure it should be no offensive or religious terms are used.

  1. Apply for Initial Approval

Submit your business details and get a no-objection certificate from SEDD. The NOC confirms that your business is allowed to operate under the chosen activity.

  1. Secure a Business Location

Every business in Sharjah must have a physical address. You can rent a commercial office or shop. Get approval from the Sharjah Municipality for the space.

  1. Prepare and Submit Documents

Here are the documents you usually need:

  • Initial approval certificate
  • Trade name reservation
  • Copy of passport & Emirates ID (for all partners)
  • Tenancy contract (Ejari)
  • Memorandum of Association (for LLCs)
  1. Pay the Fees

Pay the licensing and registration fees. Make sure that your documents are in order. Fees vary depending on activity type, structure, and location.

  1. Receive Your License

You’ll receive your official Sharjah Trade License after payment and final checks. Now, you’re ready to launch!

Types of Trade Licenses in Sharjah

Depending on what you do, you’ll need the right type of license. Five types of licenses are usually issued to businesses that want to operate in the UAE. The most popular types are:

  1. Commercial License
  2. Industrial License
  3. Professional License
  4. Freelance Permit
  5. E-Commerce License

Here’s a breakdown:

License Type What It Covers Best For
Commercial License Trading, import/export, retail, wholesale Shops, distributors, e-commerce
Industrial License Manufacturing, packaging, production Factories, production units
Professional License Services like consulting, marketing, and design Freelancers, agencies, advisors
Freelance Permit Individual creative or tech professionals Writers, developers, photographers
E-Commerce License Online selling of products and services Digital stores, online brands

Cost of a Trade License in Sharjah

Your cost depends on several factors. This may include your business type, number of visas, and office space. We’ve compiled a detailed trade license cost in Sharjah in the form of a table.

Estimated Cost Breakdown:

Item Cost (AED)
Trade License Fee 5,000 – 15,000
Name Reservation 500 – 700
Initial Approval 100 – 300
Office Rent 10,000+ (varies)
Emirates ID & Visa (per person) 2,000 – 5,000

The most affordable option is the E-commerce license. The cost of the license starts from AED 6,000.

Why Sharjah is a Smart Choice for Startups

Sharjah is the most preferred choice for entrepreneurs due to its lower setup costs. The cost is relatively low compared to Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Sharjah offers cheaper office rent and licensing fees.

Its strategic location is another advantage. Sharjah is near major ports and airports, ideal for trade. The diverse economy of Sharjah makes it highly valuable in the eyes of entrepreneurs. Including culture, tourism, industry, and education.

Sharjah’s supportive ecosystem which benefits from government initiatives and incubators. This hugely helps startups grow.

FAQs:

What is a trade license in Sharjah?

A trade license in Sharjah is an official government document that permits a business to operate legally within the emirate. It defines the business activity and ensures compliance with local laws.

Who needs a trade license in Sharjah?

Any individual or company that wants to conduct commercial, industrial, professional, or service-oriented activities in Sharjah must obtain a trade license.

What types of trade licenses are available in Sharjah?

Sharjah offers several types of trade licenses, including Commercial, Professional, Industrial, and Tourism licenses, each suited to different business activities.

How do I choose the right trade license type?

You choose the license based on your business activity. Commercial licenses are for trading activities, professional for service-based businesses, and industrial for manufacturing operations.
